record.question: Which schematic endpoints match the detailed mapped junctions?
record.reason: The 2012 Pine Valley milepoint is 1.4; schematics print 1.3 to the south junction and omit the near-trailhead Lake Valley branch. The undated GIF prints another 1.3 toward Camp where the 2021 diagram leaves the link unlabeled. Endpoint alignment and edition differences remain unresolved; these labels are not assigned to atomic legs.
